reason: Measured on the serving code path (vLLM's own DeepseekV4DecoderLayer FFN half: mhc.post_pre, MoERunner, SharedExperts, TileLangGateRouter, TileLangExperts, in captured CUDA graphs), candidate-47 with and without #1005, neither of #1005's two changes gains at the FFN sublayer. (1) The hook change does nothing on the device. On the serving path the shared expert's workspace_size is 0, so 1107 launches it on the aux stream before the router gate. #1005 moves the host launch to the post-gate hook but records the input-ready event before the gate, so the captured graph has the same dependencies. ABBA: faster in 2 of 56 cells (M=2 chain, both shapes, 0.65-0.99 us), never slower. Paired screen: 0 of 44 cells move. (2) The moe_swiglu_cast change saves at most about 1-1.5 us at M >= 24 (its standalone gain). That is below the sublayer's interval there (2400-5200 us a layer, boots 10-20 us apart), and at M <= 12 it saves nothing. ABBA: 1 cell faster, 1 slower (TP4 chain M=3). Paired: 1 faster, 2 slower (TP3 chain M=6 +0.9/+0.8 us, cold M=8 +1.7/+0.6 us). (3) Candidate-47 as built: in the ABBA, 2 cells faster and 4 slower (TP4 chain M=4 +0.5, M=6 +2.8; cold M=6 +3.7, M=40 +10.2 us). The paired screen does not reproduce the slower cells (0 of 44 move). (4) The one schedule change that does move the sublayer is a true post-gate start: the input-ready event recorded after the gate GEMM, as the 1107 hook code was written. It gains 1-3 us with warm L2 at M <= 4 (TP3) but is 2-5 us slower in 13 of 44 cells with cold L2 and the FFN prefetch, so it fails 'slower in no cell'. Keeping only the kernel half would leave a change with no gain beyond the interval at any serving M, so no corrected candidate was made.

arms.no1005: candidate-47 without #1005: 1107's tree + 0762, 0763, 0764, 0766, 0767, 0768, 0769 (git am, all apply); head a3cb50b, tree c84785e7
arms.c47: candidate-47: + 0762..0769; head 72e9de2, tree 42b63090; its 26 overlay files equal the own-marks candidate-47 overlay
arms.post (session 2 only): hook, with record_input_ready returning False: the deferred launch records the input-ready event after the gate GEMM (a true post-gate start)

harness.code_path: vLLM's DeepseekV4DecoderLayer (vllm/models/deepseek_v4_1/nvidia/model.py) built under EngineArgs' VllmConfig from the served checkpoint's config.json with the serving FFN flags (tilelang attention/linear/moe backends, V2 model runner, max_num_batched_tokens 16384); attention stubbed (the FFN half never calls it); single rank with moe_intermediate_size 576 (TP4) / 768 (TP3), i.e. a serving rank's routed (E=384, top-6, I=576/768) and shared (1 expert, I=576/768) shapes; random weights in checkpoint dtypes through process_weights_after_loading and prepare.declare_modules. Sublayer = mhc.post_pre + ffn(x, input_ids) inside kernels.mxfp8_inputs, with the layer's FFN L2 prefetch issued before and joined after, under a forward context with is_padding.
harness.not_modelled: the cross-rank all-reduce after the FFN (outside the sublayer), the NEXT-layer L2 prefetch window issued from the pre-reduce hook (the stub attention owns no weights; absent in every arm)

modes.chain: 6 distinct layers back to back per graph, timed by events around 10 (s1) / 8 (s2) replays, per layer
modes.cold: each layer preceded by a 96 MiB write (L2 evicted); in-graph timing events around prefetch + sublayer + join, per layer

harness.warmup: >= 1.5 s of graph replays before the first timed window (GPU idles at 208 MHz)
harness.session1: one arm per container, palindromic order no1005, kern, hook, c47, c47, hook, kern, no1005 (two boots each), 15 windows, medians; verdict by the boots' interval: gain = both arm boots below both no1005 boots, slower = both above
harness.session2: all variants in one process on the same layers, 12 windows, each window replaying every variant's graph of a (mode, M) in shuffled order; paired per-window deltas; verdict: gain/slower when the 95% bootstrap interval of the median delta excludes 0 on both boots

schedule_traced.no1005_and_kern: M=1 and 48: SharedExperts.maybe_forward_async before the router (workspace_size 0, MULTI_STREAM_OVERLAPPED, fold_shared True); router post-gate hook never set
schedule_traced.hook_and_c47: M=1: record_input_ready (event before the gate), router with post_gate_hook, maybe_forward_async(input_ready_recorded=True); M=48 (> 32 rows): as no1005
schedule_traced.post: M=1: record_input_ready -> False, router with post_gate_hook, maybe_forward_async records the event after the gate GEMM

bit_exact.detail: every eager, captured and after-timing output digest (all 6 layers, every M, both modes, both boots) equals no1005's

files.commands-runs.log: every run's exact command, host state inside the GPU lock, UTC times, exit code
files.out/: raw outputs of every run (s1-*-b1/b2, s2-pair-b1/b2, smoke and exploration runs) and the two summaries
files.overlays/: arm identities and per-file SHA-256 prefixes
